what: every re-encoding tool given a .mxf output failed in the muxer after the encode started ("Codec 'aac' is not supported by the bitstream filter 'pcm_rechunk'", "Could not write header", nothing written; cut --accurate/--smart/--remove, fit, color, audio, loudness, export, pad, loop, reverse, crop, freeze, speedramp, denoise, deinterlace, join), and a dry run said completed
escaped: #488 added the container-codec check for .webm only; MXF, the other muxer that refuses the tools' libx264 and AAC, was not on the list, and no test wrote a re-encoded MXF
mechanism: runner._check_container_codecs reads a table of what each muxer takes (_CONTAINER_ENCODERS) for every ffmpeg command, dry runs included; the .mxf entry refuses H.264/HEVC and AAC; test_an_mxf_output_of_a_reencode_is_refused_before_ffmpeg_runs runs seven tools through it
